recent_articles.title: Ambulance out of CM Revanth’s convoy, now reduced to three from 11 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **A. Revanth Reddy**, the Chief Minister, has drastically reduced his official convoy from nine vehicles to just three as part of a fuel conservation initiative following Prime Minister Narendra Modi's call due to the West Asia crisis.  The decision resulted in the removal of an ambulance equipped with a doctor and support staff, which previously trailed the convoy for emergency medical response. While the reduction has minimized traffic disruptions, it has also raised concerns among security personnel about increased risks associated with commuters deliberately slowing down or filming the convoy.

recent_articles.title: Cabinet clears 2.5 lakh houses, ₹587 crore for PRLSI - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana** Cabinet approved a range of initiatives, including the launch of the second phase of Indiramma houses and funding for the Palamuru-Rangareddy Lift Irrigation Scheme.  **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** announced plans to complete unfinished Indiramma houses and allocate funds for their completion. The Cabinet also allocated ₹1,000 crore for the upcoming Godavari Pushkarams and the mid-day meal scheme in all junior colleges. Additionally, **Ponguleti Srinivas Reddy**, Minister for Revenue and Housing, stated that the government will provide financial assistance to complete unfinished Indiramma houses and will allocate funds for construction of one lakh low-income group (LIG) houses in 24 Assembly constituencies.

recent_articles.title: Push for public transport exposes structural gaps - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** push for public transport, particularly metro rail, has prompted politicians and bureaucrats to use such systems. However, the renewed spotlight on public transit highlights a gap between policy intent and on-ground delivery.  Years of underinvestment in mass rapid transit systems have led to stalled projects like the Hyderabad Metro’s second phase and the Multi-Modal Transport System (MMTS) network. While efforts are underway to improve connectivity and funding, challenges remain, including securing approvals for expansion and procuring new train sets. The State government is also exploring a Rapid Rail Transit System (RRTS), but its suitability for urban settings remains questioned.

recent_articles.title: Fuel price hike negatively impacts economy, triggers rise in essential commodity prices: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **A Revanth Reddy**, **Telangana Chief Minister**, criticized the **Union Government’s** decision to increase petrol and diesel prices, arguing it would negatively impact the economy and ordinary citizens. He accused the government of mismanaging the economy through “inefficient governance” and “ill-conceived policies,” claiming that the fuel price hike was a breach of public trust and a misleading tactic for electoral gains.  He demanded the immediate withdrawal of the increase.

recent_articles.title: Singareni’s past glory will be restored through new mines, new jobs: Minister Vivek Venkataswamy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dr. G. Vivek Venkataswamy**, **Minister for Labour, Mines & Geology**, emphasized the state government's commitment to restoring the glory of **Singareni Collieries Company Limited (SCCL)** through new coal mines and employment opportunities. He highlighted the Ramakrishnapur Opencast (RKP OC) Phase-2 project's potential to create 5,000 jobs and urged collaboration between workers and officials for SCCL's growth.  **A. Revanth Reddy**, **Chief Minister**, is aware of the issue regarding employee perks, while **Gaddam Vamsi Krishna**, **Peddapalli MP**, is advocating for a ₹10,000 monthly pension for retired SCCL workers in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: Chief Minister Revanth Reddy meets Governor - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy** invited **Governor Shiv Pratap Shukla** to a program on June 12th, celebrating the reopening of schools. The program will feature the administration of a mass pledge against tobacco, alcohol, and drugs, along with the distribution of educational kits containing uniforms, textbooks, notebooks, school bags, sportswear, and other study materials.

recent_articles.title: Education Budget will grow every year, says Telangana CM Revanth Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** announced that the **Telangana government** will prioritize education, aiming for a 15% allocation in future budgets, gradually increasing from the current 7.6%.  He highlighted the implementation of several initiatives since December 2023, including teacher recruitment, DSC notifications, and global exchange programs. The "Exclusive Education Week" celebrations aim to showcase progress and improve learning facilities across the state. **Mr. Reddy** emphasized that education is an investment in the future and stressed the importance of teachers in building a better society.

recent_articles.title: Bandi Bhagirath’s case takes serious turn with Telangana CM ordering special team for comprehensive probe - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **A. Revanth Reddy**, **Telangana Chief Minister**, has demanded an immediate investigation into allegations of sexual harassment against the son of **Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar**, **Bandi Bhagirath**.  The Chief Minister, who is also the Home Minister, instructed the Director General of Police (DGP), **C.V. Anand**, to launch a probe into the case registered at Pet Basheerabad Police Station. The investigation follows allegations that the police have been slow to act on the complaint lodged by the alleged victim on May 8th.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi assures more support to Telangana, asks CM Revanth to collaborate with him - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** assured **Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** that the **Central government** would continue to support its development, emphasizing the importance of state-level progress for a developed India by 2047.  During his visit on May 10, 2026, **Modi** inaugurated several developmental projects worth ₹9,400 crore, including industrial parks and railway infrastructure, aiming to make Telangana a manufacturing hub. He highlighted the government's commitment to creating employment opportunities and reviving the textile industry through schemes like PM Mitra Park at Warangal and investments in infrastructure development.  The Prime Minister also emphasized the importance of energy security with the launch of the Malkapur terminal.

recent_articles.title: DGP calls for public partnership to curb drug menace - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **C.V. Anand**, **Director General of Police** of Telangana, convened a review meeting for the Elite Action Group for Drug Law Enforcement (EAGLE) force to address the growing drug menace in the state.  He emphasized the need for public cooperation and stressed that curbing drug abuse requires a collective effort involving police, educational institutions, and society at large. **Anand** highlighted the increase in drug-related offenses and arrests, noting that investigations are extending beyond street-level suppliers to those orchestrating operations. He directed officials to strengthen enforcement through advanced technology, financial investigations, and action against foreign syndicates while also raising concerns over the response of educational institutions to drug-related incidents involving students.

recent_articles.title: Telangana CM Revanth directs police to minimise public inconvenience during VIP movement - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **A. Revanth Reddy**, Chief Minister of **Telangana**, directed the **DGP C.V. Anand** to ensure smooth traffic flow during convoy movements and the movement of other dignitaries across the state.  Following a traffic congestion incident near the airport, Reddy instructed officials to avoid prolonged road waits due to convoy arrangements and stressed action against responsible personnel. The DGP convened a video conference with police officers from various commissionerates, emphasizing the need for streamlined traffic regulation and the establishment of a dedicated Traffic Bureau.

recent_articles.title: KTR accuses Revanth Reddy govt. of betrayal to 14L students over fee reimbursement - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K.T. Rama Rao**, working president of the **Bharatiya Rashtra Samithi (BRS)**, criticized the **Telangana Government** for delaying fee reimbursement payments to students from marginalized communities.  He accused the government of dismantling the scheme and causing financial distress in the education sector. **KTR** demanded the immediate withdrawal of the order and an apology from the Chief Minister. He also highlighted the impact on over 2,500 educational institutions and warned of statewide protests if the issue is not addressed.

recent_articles.title: Telangana sees more road accidents, fewer deaths in first quadrimester of 2026 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Telangana** saw a mixed trend in road accident data for the first four months of 2026, with a rise in crashes and a decrease in fatalities.  While accidents increased by 2.5% to 9,313 between January and April this year, deaths fell to 2,363, marking a 15.3% decline from 2025. The **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** launched the ‘Arrive Alive’ campaign in January to promote responsible driving and reduce accidents and fatalities.  The state attributed the reduction in deaths to a comprehensive road safety action plan that includes stricter enforcement of traffic rules, checks on overloading, action against unfit and illegally modified vehicles, and improvements in post-crash response.

recent_articles.title: BRS office is a centre of ‘false propaganda’: Govt. Whip Adi Srinivas - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Adi Srinivas**, the **Congress** government whip, criticized the **BRS** government's handling of job creation in Telangana. He accused the BRS of misleading unemployed youth by failing to fill positions during its rule and now falsely claiming responsibility for recent job drives.  Srinivas highlighted the Congress government's transparency in providing nearly 70,000 jobs through recruitment ceremonies across Hyderabad.  He also criticized former **BRS** leader T. Jeevan Reddy for changing his stance on the issue after joining the party.

recent_articles.title: Telangana government to clear ₹6,000 crore retirement benefits in 100 days, promises Revanth Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** assured government employees that the state would clear retirement benefits worth ₹6,000 crore within 100 days and announced a series of measures aimed at addressing employee welfare.  He highlighted key decisions made by his administration, including timely salary payments and free and transparent union elections.

recent_articles.title: DGP Shivadhar Reddy to be made TS State Security Advisor - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **B. Shivadhar Reddy**, the outgoing Director General of Police, is expected to be appointed as **Telangana’s State Security Advisor** in the rank of Chief Secretary. This move comes after the government named **C.V. Anand** as the new DGP and follows a pattern of previous appointments where retired IPS officers have been given advisory roles.  The appointment marks a departure from past practice, making it the first such position for a retired IPS officer.

recent_articles.title: DGP Shivadhar Reddy to be made TS State Security Advisor - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **B. Shivadhar Reddy**, the outgoing Director General of Police, is expected to be appointed as **Telangana's State Security Advisor** in the rank of Chief Secretary. This move comes after the government named C.V. Anand as the new DGP and follows a precedent set by the previous BRS regime with former DGP Anurag Sharma holding a similar advisory role.  The appointment marks a significant departure from past practices, creating a dedicated position for a retired IPS officer.

recent_articles.title: CV Anand calls on Telangana CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **C.V. Anand**, the newly appointed **Director General of Police**, met with **Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** at the Integrated Command Control Centre (ICCC) in Hyderabad on Wednesday.  Anand thanked Reddy for the opportunity to serve as DGP and assured him he would work diligently to enhance safety and security. The incumbent DGP, **B. Shivadhar Reddy**, is set to demit office on Thursday.

recent_articles.title: Mukunda Reddy takes charge as I&PR Special Commissioner - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **G. Mukunda Reddy** assumed the role of Special Commissioner and Ex-officio Secretary of the **State Information and Public Relations Department**, succeeding **C.H. Priyanka**.  He emphasized the importance of disseminating government welfare programs to the public, urging officials to follow directives set by Chief Minister **A. Revanth Reddy** and Minister for Revenue, Housing, Information and Public Relations **Ponguleti Srinivasa Reddy**. The event was attended by senior officials from the department.

recent_articles.title: BRS outlived its purpose and has lost its relevance, says Revanth - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** stated that the **Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS)** is irrelevant in Telangana and has no future, while also demanding a full-fledged CBI probe into alleged irregularities in the Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Project.  He criticized **K Chandrasekhar Rao**, claiming he should respond to allegations made by his daughter, **Kavitha**. **Revanth Reddy** believes the High Court's judgment on the PC Ghose Commission was correct and that investigations into phone tapping and Formula E race cases are progressing under court monitoring. He predicted the next elections would be between the Congress alliance and the BRS-BJP alliance.

recent_articles.title: Goud, Chamala fault Kavitha for targeting CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mahesh Kumar Goud**, president of the Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC), and **Chamala Kiran Kumar Reddy**, Lok Sabha member, praised **K. Kavitha**, chief of the **Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS)**, for acknowledging the BRS government's alleged looting during its decade-long rule.  **Goud** questioned her motives for entering politics and **Reddy** criticized her remarks comparing the Chief Minister to Hitler, asserting that such actions would not garner support from the people of Telangana.

recent_articles.title: Kavitha floats ‘Telangana Rashtra Sena’, targets KCR and BRS - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kalvakuntla Kavitha**, founder of the new political party **Telangana Rashtra Sena (TRS)**, launched her initiative on April 25, 2026.  Kavitha's party seeks to reclaim the legacy of the Telangana statehood movement and criticizes the current BRS leadership under **K. Chandrashekar Rao**, accusing him of being "changed" and no longer representing the people. Kavitha also claims she was expelled from the BRS for questioning alleged corruption in a major irrigation project. The TRS chief outlined five assurances: free education, free treatment, support for farmers, job creation, and social justice.

recent_articles.title: Revanth, Uttam to meet CBI Directorfor expediting Kaleshwaram probe - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Revanth Reddy** and **Irrigation Minister N. Uttam Kumar Reddy** plan to meet the **CBI Director** to urge for expedited investigation into alleged irregularities in the Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Project. The High Court upheld the constitution of the Justice P. C. Ghose Commission, finding no fault with its findings or legal validity.  The Ministers will consult senior advocate Abhishek Manu Singhvi before deciding whether to appeal to the Supreme Court.

recent_articles.title: Tempers rise on second day of stir as Telangana RTC calls for temporary driver applications - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **TGSRTC** workers continued their strike on Thursday, with one worker attempting suicide in protest of delayed absorption into the government. **E. Venkanna**, chairman of the **RTC Joint Action Committee**, condemned the incident and demanded better treatment from the Telangana government. The committee also accused police of preventing peaceful protests and called for intervention by **Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy**.  The corporation ran all its hire buses and electric buses to maintain service, but this proved inadequate as they were unable to meet demand.

recent_articles.title: CM for speeding up land acquisition for allotment to industries - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** directed officials to expedite land acquisition for industrial development projects, prioritizing firms with global reputations in the allocation process.  He also urged a planned approach to facility development, considering future needs of industries. The meeting reviewed investments and pending implementation plans from the Davos and Telangana Rising summits, with **Revanth Reddy** suggesting water supply solutions for data centers using STPs.
